description: Add page numbers to a PDF — starting where you want, skipping the pages that should stay clean. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The PDF to number, base64-encoded. A data: URL prefix is stripped.

format.description: How the label reads. plain writes "3", of writes "3 of 20", page-of writes "Page 3 of 20". The total counts numbered pages rather than sheets, so an extract of three pages starting at 47 reads "47 of 49".

from.description: The first sheet to print a number on, counted from 1. Sheets before it are left clean, so passing 3 skips a title page and a contents page.

margin.description: Distance from the page edge to the number, in points (1/72 inch). 28 when omitted, about a centimetre.

name.description: Base name for the output file; a .pdf ending is dropped and the response names it <name>-numbered.pdf.

position.description: Where the number sits on each page: bottom-centre, bottom-right, bottom-left, top-right or top-centre. `margin` is measured in from those edges.

size.description: Font size of the number in points. 10 when omitted.

startAt.description: The number printed on the first numbered sheet; later sheets count up from it. 1 by default; an extract from a longer bundle might start at 47.

name: pdf_page_numbers
title: Add Page Numbers to PDF
